description: Cumulative later editorial corrections to emotion-verse mappings, made AFTER the relevant batch's final-review.json was already closed. This file never edits a closed batch's final-review.json to pretend a different decision was made at the time — see backend/data/emotion-candidates/README.md's "Later editorial corrections" section. Applied last (after every batch final review) by backend/src/scripts/consolidateCurrentMappings.ts when generating consolidated/approved-mappings-current.json and consolidated/duplicate-mappings-current.json. A single stable, cumulative file — new corrections are appended here, not scattered across one file per correction.
note: Uses the same review-decision vocabulary as batches/batch-N/final-review.json (`reject`/`hold`) plus `add` for a future explicitly-approved addition. `type: "reject"`/`"hold"` block exactly the named (verseKey, emotionKey) pair from the current approved set, regardless of how or when it was previously approved (direct KEEP, supplemental KEEP, or overlap consolidation) — never the whole verseKey, and never any other emotionKey for the same verse.

corrections.priorProvenance: overlap: batches/batch-3/overlaps.json (sourceEmotionKeys: ["repentant"]), consolidated into consolidated/approved-mappings-preview.json (historical Phase 5C, sourceBatches: ["3"])
corrections.reason: The complete ayah (2:222) is specifically about menstruation and marital relations ("...فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ..."). Although the ayah ends with "إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ", the full ayah is too context-specific to surface as a general Seeking Guidance ayah.
corrections.note: This pair was never the subject of a direct human KEEP/REJECT decision under seeking_guidance in any batch final-review.json — it entered the approved set purely via the Batch 3 overlap-consolidation step. This correction blocks only (2:222, seeking_guidance); 2:222 remains eligible for any other emotion, and verse 2:222 itself is untouched in quran.sqlite/the general Quran reading flow.
